gap_reasons: The delivered contribution is a specialized stationary, two-parameter experiment comparison for a fixed exponential kernel and parameter rectangle; the causal resolvent introduces no additional identification result. proof_attempt_summary: Derived the stationary two-parameter Hawkes-to-CIR experiment comparison and causal pulse minimax limit without removing immigration nuisance or stationary initial information. Completed source-scope and scaling repairs, resolved all discovery graph statements, and obtained a mathematical PASS with all 14 citations verified-attested; graph fsck passes 51 commits. The delivered package was graded incremental below the field floor and not salvageable within scope: a certified numerical minimax rule and finite-horizon risk/precision program remains unexecuted, one positioning finding remains unrepaired, and no Lean formalization was launched or claimed.
tldr: The complete original stationary near-critical Hawkes experiment is uniformly equivalent, in both Le Cam deficiency directions, to one stationary CIR path on a fixed time interval, with both immigration and criticality unknown. The proved stationary density field, fractional inverse-intensity bound and joint likelihood control support total parameter-independent comparison kernels. A public conservative envelope decays as \(O((\log\log\log T)^{-1})\); this order is optimal only for the explicitly substituted conservative comparison budget. The original all-procedure pulse minimax risk converges to a strictly positive CIR value, with data-only attaining procedures, certified finite-game approximation and a least-favorable-prior variational characterization.
gap: The process theorem of \cite{CoutinMassatReveillac2026Quantification} supplies a quantitative approximation of trajectories, not a quantitative comparison of likelihood-weighted stationary experiments. Qualitative information saturation does not give a finite-horizon remainder for the original all-procedure pulse risk.
fill: Derive stationary density and joint likelihood error budgets, convert a public-reference coupling into two-sided comparison kernels, and determine the explicit optimized deficiency envelope without guessing a rate. The decision theorem transfers that envelope to the nuisance-inclusive minimax pulse risk under the same squared-error loss.
